test.create_query: CREATE TABLE replacing_final_overlap (sid UInt64, ts DateTime64(3), value Float64) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree ORDER BY (sid, ts)
CREATE TABLE replacing_final_overlap_ver (sid UInt64, ts DateTime64(3), value Float64, ver UInt32) ENGINE = ReplacingMergeTree(ver) ORDER BY (sid, ts)
CREATE TABLE collapsing_final_overlap (sid UInt64, ts DateTime64(3), value Float64, sign Int8) ENGINE = CollapsingMergeTree(sign) ORDER BY (sid, ts)
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO replacing_final_overlap SELECT number % 10000, toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3) + toIntervalMillisecond(intDiv(number, 10000) * 15000), (number % 997) / 7.0 FROM numbers(8000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 500000, max_insert_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO replacing_final_overlap_ver SELECT number % 10000, toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3) + toIntervalMillisecond(intDiv(number % 4000000, 10000) * 15000), (number % 997) / 7.0, toUInt32(intDiv(number, 500000)) FROM numbers(8000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 500000, max_insert_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO collapsing_final_overlap SELECT number % 10000, toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3) + toIntervalMillisecond(intDiv(number, 10000) * 15000), (number % 997) / 7.0, 1 FROM numbers(8000000) SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 500000, max_insert_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0

INSERT INTO collapsing_final_overlap SELECT number % 10000, toDateTime64('2026-01-01 00:00:00', 3) + toIntervalMillisecond(intDiv(number, 10000) * 15000), (number % 997) / 7.0, -1 FROM numbers(8000000) WHERE number % 10 = 0 SETTINGS max_threads = 1, max_insert_threads = 1, max_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_rows = 500000, max_insert_block_size = 500000, min_insert_block_size_bytes = 0
test.query: SELECT sid, ts, value FROM replacing_final_overlap FINAL FORMAT Null
SELECT sid, ts, value FROM replacing_final_overlap FINAL FORMAT Null SETTINGS enable_vertical_final = 0
SELECT sid, ts, value, ver FROM replacing_final_overlap_ver FINAL FORMAT Null
SELECT sid, ts, value FROM collapsing_final_overlap FINAL FORMAT Null
